question: What specific types of attacks must the technical solutions for high-risk AI systems address, where appropriate, to counter AI-specific vulnerabilities?
reference: To address AI-specific vulnerabilities, technical solutions must include measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve, and control attacks such as data poisoning, model poisoning, adversarial examples or model evasion, confidentiality attacks, and model flaws.

question: Quelles mesures minimales le responsable du traitement doit-il mettre en œuvre pour protéger les intérêts d'une personne concernée par une décision individuelle automatisée fondée sur un contrat ou un consentement ?
reference: Le responsable du traitement doit mettre en œuvre des mesures appropriées incluant au moins le droit d'obtenir une intervention humaine, d'exprimer son point de vue et de contester la décision.

question: What specific information must a controller provide to a data subject when the personal data have not been obtained directly from them?
reference: When personal data are not obtained from the data subject, the controller must provide the data subject with the controller's and representative's identity and contact details, the DPO's contact details, the processing purposes and legal basis, the categories of data concerned, any recipients or categories of recipients, and details regarding any intended international transfers including adequacy decisions or appropriate safeguards.

question: Dans quels cas précis une entreprise de moins de 250 employés est-elle tout de même tenue de tenir un registre des activités de traitement ?
reference: Une entreprise de moins de 250 employés doit tenir ce registre si son traitement n'est pas occasionnel, s'il est susceptible de comporter un risque pour les droits et libertés des personnes, ou s'il porte sur des catégories particulières de données ou des données relatives à des condamnations pénales et infractions.

question: Dans quelles situations précises une autorité de surveillance du marché doit-elle inviter un fournisseur à mettre un terme à une non-conformité formelle?
reference: Une autorité de surveillance du marché invite le fournisseur à mettre un terme à une non-conformité formelle si le marquage CE a été apposé en violation de l'article 48, si le marquage CE n'a pas été apposé, si la déclaration UE de conformité n'a pas été établie ou l'a été incorrectement, si l'enregistrement dans la base de données de l'UE n'a pas été effectué, si aucun mandataire n'a été désigné le cas échéant, ou si la documentation technique n'est pas disponible.

question: To what obligations may adherence to the codes of practice be limited for providers of general-purpose AI models that do not present systemic risks?
reference: For providers of general-purpose AI models not presenting systemic risks, adherence to the codes of practice may be limited to the obligations provided for in Article 53, unless they explicitly declare their interest in joining the full code.

question: By what date must Member States identify and publish the list of public authorities or bodies that protect fundamental rights in relation to AI systems?
reference: By 2 November 2024, each Member State shall identify the public authorities or bodies protecting fundamental rights, make the list publicly available, notify it to the Commission and other Member States, and keep it up to date.

question: Under what specific conditions may a data transfer to a third country take place when no other provisions or derogations apply?
reference: Such a transfer may only take place if it is not repetitive, concerns only a limited number of data subjects, is necessary for compelling legitimate interests of the controller that are not overridden by the data subject's rights, and the controller has assessed all circumstances and provided suitable safeguards based on that assessment.

question: Quel droit possède chaque personne concernée si elle estime que ses droits en matière de protection des données ont été violés lors d'un traitement ?
reference: Chaque personne concernée a droit à un recours juridictionnel effectif si elle considère que les droits que lui confère le règlement ont été violés du fait d'un traitement de ses données effectué en violation de celui-ci.
note: several articles answer it (GDPR 77, 79 and 82 all give a right)

question: De quoi doit-il être tenu compte lors de l'adoption d'actes d'exécution concernant des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle qui sont des composants de sécurité en vertu du règlement sur l'intelligence artificielle?
reference: Lors de l'adoption d'actes d'exécution relatifs à des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle qui sont des composants de sécurité, il doit être tenu compte des exigences énoncées au chapitre III, section 2, du règlement (UE) 2024/1689.
note: Articles 102 to 110 add this same sentence to eight regulations

question: Est-ce qu'une organisation de protection des données peut introduire une réclamation auprès d'une autorité de contrôle sans avoir reçu de mandat de la personne concernée ?
reference: Oui, les États membres peuvent prévoir qu'un organisme, une organisation ou une association a le droit d'introduire une réclamation et d'exercer les recours juridiques indépendamment de tout mandat, s'il estime que les droits d'une personne concernée ont été violés.

question: Within what timeframe must a supervisory authority inform a data subject about the progress or outcome of their lodged complaint to avoid the data subject having a right to an effective judicial remedy?
reference: A supervisory authority must inform the data subject on the progress or outcome of the complaint within three months.

question: Which specific criminal offences are included in the list referred to for certain uses of AI systems?
reference: The list of criminal offences includes terrorism, trafficking in human beings, sexual exploitation of children and child pornography, illicit trafficking in drugs, weapons, or nuclear materials, murder, grievous bodily injury, illicit trade in human organs or tissue, kidnapping, crimes within the jurisdiction of the International Criminal Court, unlawful seizure of aircraft or ships, rape, environmental crime, organised or armed robbery, sabotage, and participation in a criminal organisation involved in these offences.
note: near-duplicate of q001 (Annex II), and 'certain uses' is vague

question: What conditions must the experts selected by the Commission for the scientific panel of independent experts be able to demonstrate?
reference: Experts must demonstrate up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in AI, specific expertise and competence in the field, independence from any provider of AI systems or general-purpose AI models, and the ability to carry out activities diligently, accurately, and objectively.
note: duplicate of q008 (conditions for the scientific panel's experts)

question: Quelles informations l'autorité notifiante doit-elle fournir à la Commission concernant les organismes notifiés, et à quel moment ?
reference: L'autorité notifiante doit fournir à la Commission, sur demande, toutes les informations utiles relatives à la notification ou au maintien de la compétence de l'organisme notifié concerné.

question: Quelles sont les obligations de l'autorité notifiante en cas de restriction, de suspension ou de retrait d'une désignation d'organisme notifié ?
reference: En cas de restriction, de suspension ou de retrait d'une désignation, l'autorité notifiante doit évaluer l'incidence sur les certificats, transmettre un rapport aux autres États membres et à la Commission sous trois mois, exiger de l'organisme la suspension ou le retrait des certificats délivrés à tort, en informer la Commission et les États membres, et fournir les informations pertinentes à l'autorité nationale compétente du pays où le fournisseur a son siège.

question: Dans quelle situation le règlement s'applique-t-il au traitement de données par un responsable du traitement non établi dans l'Union, mais dans un lieu régi par le droit d'un État membre en vertu du droit international public ?
reference: Le règlement s'applique lorsque ce traitement est effectué par un responsable du traitement non établi dans l'Union mais situé dans un lieu où le droit d'un État membre s'applique en vertu du droit international public.

question: What signing details must be included in the EU declaration of conformity for high-risk AI systems?
reference: The EU declaration of conformity must include the place and date of issue, the name and function of the signatory, an indication of who they signed for or on behalf of, and a signature.
note: near-duplicate of q002 (contents of the EU declaration of conformity)

question: How can public authorities reconcile public access to official documents with the right to the protection of personal data?
reference: Public authorities, public bodies, or private bodies performing a public interest task may disclose personal data in official documents in accordance with applicable Union or Member State law to reconcile public access with personal data protection.

question: Quels documents les organismes notifiés doivent-ils fournir à l'autorité notifiante pour faciliter ses activités de surveillance et d'évaluation ?
reference: Les organismes notifiés mettent à la disposition de l'autorité notifiante et lui soumettent sur demande toute la documentation pertinente, y compris celle des fournisseurs, afin de lui permettre de réaliser ses activités d'évaluation, de désignation, de notification et de surveillance et pour faciliter les évaluations de cette section.

question: Quel organe européen peut adopter des actes d'exécution pour définir les modalités de l'échange d'informations par voie électronique entre les autorités de contrôle et le comité?
reference: La Commission peut adopter des actes d'exécution de portée générale afin de définir les modalités de l'échange d'informations par voie électronique entre les autorités de contrôle, et entre ces autorités et le comité.

question: Who is liable to pay compensation to a person who has suffered material or non-material damage due to an infringement of the regulation?
reference: Any person who has suffered material or non-material damage as a result of a regulation infringement has the right to receive compensation from the controller or processor.

question: How does the Commission ensure appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies involved in conformity assessment procedures for high-risk AI systems?
reference: The Commission ensures coordination and cooperation between notified bodies by establishing and properly operating a sectoral group of notified bodies.

question: Under what conditions can Union or Member State law restrict data protection rights and obligations?
reference: Union or Member State law may restrict data protection rights and obligations through a legislative measure if the restriction respects the essence of fundamental rights and freedoms and is a necessary and proportionate measure in a democratic society to safeguard objectives such as national security, defence, public security, the prevention or prosecution of criminal offences, or other important general public interests.

question: Où sont enregistrés les systèmes d'IA à haut risque utilisés dans les domaines de la migration et de l'asile, et qui a accès à ces informations ?
reference: Ces systèmes d'IA sont enregistrés dans une section sécurisée non publique de la base de données de l'UE, et seules la Commission ainsi que les autorités nationales compétentes ont accès à ces sections restreintes.

question: Quelle est la durée de validité maximale des mesures provisoires qu'une autorité de contrôle peut adopter d'urgence pour protéger les droits des personnes ?
reference: La durée de validité des mesures provisoires adoptées en urgence par une autorité de contrôle ne peut excéder trois mois.

question: At what point and with whom must Member States consult regarding legislative or regulatory measures related to data processing?
reference: Member States must consult the supervisory authority during the preparation of proposals for national legislative measures, or regulatory measures based on them, that relate to data processing.

question: How should high-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market be developed regarding feedback loops?
reference: They must be developed to eliminate or reduce as far as possible the risk of biased outputs influencing future inputs, and to ensure that such feedback loops are addressed with appropriate mitigation measures.
note: duplicate of q003 (feedback loops in systems that keep learning)

question: Dans quelles circonstances l'interdiction générale de prendre des décisions individuelles automatisées ne s'applique-t-elle pas selon le règlement ?
reference: L'interdiction ne s'applique pas si la décision est nécessaire à la conclusion ou à l'exécution d'un contrat, si elle est autorisée par le droit de l'Union ou d'un État membre prévoyant des mesures de sauvegarde appropriées, ou si elle est fondée sur le consentement explicite de la personne concernée.

question: Quelles informations concernant les transferts de données vers des pays tiers doivent être fournies à la personne concernée lorsque ses données n'ont pas été collectées auprès d'elle ?
reference: Le responsable du traitement doit indiquer l'existence ou l'absence d'une décision d'adéquation de la Commission, ou la référence aux garanties appropriées et les moyens d'en obtenir une copie.
note: second question on c003's paragraph

question: What specific information must be included in the record of processing activities maintained by a controller?
reference: The record of processing activities must contain the names and contact details of the controller, joint controller, representative, and data protection officer; the purposes of processing; categories of data subjects and personal data; categories of recipients including those in third countries; details of international data transfers and safeguards where applicable; and, where possible, the envisaged time limits for erasure.

question: Que doit faire l'autorité de surveillance du marché si une non-conformité formelle persiste malgré les mesures initiales ?
reference: Si la non-conformité persiste, l'autorité de surveillance du marché prend toutes les mesures appropriées et proportionnées pour restreindre ou interdire la mise à disposition du système d'IA à haut risque sur le marché ou pour assurer son rappel ou son retrait sans tarder.

question: Quel organisme facilite la révision des codes de bonne pratique et évalue les normes disponibles ?
reference: Le Bureau de l'IA encourage et facilite le réexamen et l'adaptation des codes de bonne pratique et participe à l'évaluation des normes disponibles.

question: What can a public authority protecting fundamental rights do if the available documentation is not enough to determine if a high-risk AI system infringes Union law?
reference: The public authority may make a reasoned request to the market surveillance authority to organize testing of the high-risk AI system through technical means.

question: What action must Member States take regarding national provisions that set limits on personal data transfers to third countries for important reasons of public interest in the absence of an adequacy decision?
reference: Member States must notify such provisions to the Commission.

question: In which courts can a data subject bring judicial proceedings against a controller or processor?
reference: Proceedings can be brought before the courts of the Member State where the controller or processor has an establishment, or alternatively where the data subject has their habitual residence, unless the controller or processor is a public authority acting in the exercise of its public powers.

question: What kind of bodies or organisations can a data subject mandate to lodge a complaint or exercise data protection rights on their behalf?
reference: A data subject can mandate a properly constituted not-for-profit body, organisation, or association that has public interest statutory objectives and is active in the field of protecting personal data rights and freedoms.

question: What must a supervisory authority do when proceedings are brought against its decision that was preceded by an opinion or decision of the Board in the consistency mechanism?
reference: When proceedings are brought against a supervisory authority's decision that was preceded by an opinion or decision of the Board in the consistency mechanism, the supervisory authority must forward that opinion or decision to the court.

question: What are the specific tasks of the scientific panel of independent experts regarding cross-border market surveillance activities and the Union safeguard procedure?
reference: The scientific panel of independent experts is tasked with supporting cross-border market surveillance activities without prejudice to market surveillance authorities' powers, and supporting the AI Office in carrying out its duties under the Union safeguard procedure.

question: Which institution is responsible for investigating cases where there are doubts regarding the competence of a notified body?
reference: The Commission is responsible for investigating cases where there are doubts about the competence of a notified body or its continued fulfillment of requirements and responsibilities.

question: Par quel moyen l'autorité notifiante doit-elle informer la Commission et les autres États membres des modifications apportées à la notification d'un organisme notifié ?
reference: L'autorité notifiante notifie ces modifications au moyen de l'outil de notification électronique visé à l'article 30, paragraphe 2.

question: Dans quelles conditions le règlement s'applique-t-il au traitement des données effectué par un établissement d'un responsable du traitement, indépendamment du lieu où se déroule le traitement ?
reference: Le règlement s'applique lorsque le traitement des données à caractère personnel est effectué dans le cadre des activités d'un établissement d'un responsable du traitement ou d'un sous-traitant situé sur le territoire de l'Union, que ce traitement ait lieu ou non au sein de l'Union.

question: What specific statement must be included in the EU declaration of conformity when an AI system involves the processing of personal data?
reference: When an AI system involves the processing of personal data, the EU declaration of conformity must include a statement that the AI system complies with Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680.
note: another Annex V question (q002, c018)

question: De quelle manière les organismes notifiés doivent-ils tenir compte de la taille des fournisseurs et de la complexité des systèmes d'IA dans leurs activités ?
reference: Les organismes notifiés doivent éviter les charges inutiles pour les fournisseurs, en particulier afin de réduire au minimum les charges administratives et les coûts de mise en conformité pour les microentreprises et les petites entreprises, tout en respectant le degré de rigueur et le niveau de protection requis pour garantir la conformité.

question: What right does a controller or processor have after paying full compensation for damage caused by processing?
reference: A controller or processor that has paid full compensation for the damage is entitled to claim back from the other involved controllers or processors the portion of compensation that corresponds to their respective responsibility for the damage.

question: How must notified bodies be involved in the sectoral group that the Commission sets up for them?
reference: Each notifying authority must ensure that the bodies it has notified participate in the work of the designated coordination group, either directly or through designated representatives.
note: reworded: 'what must each notifying authority ensure' has answers in Arts 28-36; was: What must each notifying authority ensure regarding the notified bodies it has designated?

question: Quels éléments spécifiques les mesures législatives limitant la portée des obligations et des droits du RGPD doivent-elles contenir au minimum ?
reference: Les mesures législatives doivent contenir des dispositions spécifiques relatives aux finalités du traitement, aux catégories de données, à l'étendue des limitations, aux garanties contre les abus ou transferts illicites, à la détermination du responsable du traitement, aux durées de conservation, aux risques pour les droits des personnes, ainsi qu'au droit des personnes d'être informées de la limitation.

question: Who is required to register a non-high-risk AI system in the EU database before it is placed on the market or put into service?
reference: The provider or, where applicable, the authorised representative must register themselves and the non-high-risk AI system in the EU database before placing it on the market or putting it into service.

question: Dans quel délai et à quelle majorité le comité doit-il adopter un avis ou une décision contraignante dans le cadre de la procédure d'urgence ?
reference: L'avis d'urgence ou la décision contraignante d'urgence est adopté dans un délai de deux semaines à la majorité simple des membres du comité.

question: Dans quelle situation précise le responsable du traitement est-il tenu de consulter l'autorité de contrôle avant de procéder au traitement ?
reference: Le responsable du traitement doit consulter l'autorité de contrôle au préalable lorsqu'une analyse d'impact indique que le traitement présenterait un risque élevé en l'absence de mesures d'atténuation.

question: How should the development of benchmarks and measurement methodologies for AI systems be encouraged, and who is involved in this process?
reference: The Commission, in cooperation with relevant stakeholders and organisations such as metrology and benchmarking authorities, shall encourage the development of benchmarks and measurement methodologies to address the technical aspects of measuring accuracy and robustness.

question: What right does a data subject have regarding decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling?
reference: A data subject has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects concerning them or similarly significantly affects them.

question: What additional information must a controller provide to a data subject when personal data have not been obtained directly from them, in order to ensure fair and transparent processing?
reference: The controller must provide the storage period or its determining criteria, the legitimate interests pursued if processing is based on point (f) of Article 6(1), information about the rights to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and data portability, and the right to withdraw consent where applicable.

question: Who must make the record of processing activities available to the supervisory authority upon request?
reference: The controller or the processor and, where applicable, their representative must make the record available to the supervisory authority on request.

question: Which entities are permitted by the AI Office to take part in drafting codes of practice for general-purpose AI models?
reference: The AI Office may invite all providers of general-purpose AI models and relevant national competent authorities to participate, while civil society organisations, industry, academia, downstream providers, and independent experts may support the process.
note: fourth Art. 56 question in dev (q007, c006, c033)

question: How must national public authorities handle information and documentation they obtain regarding fundamental rights protection in relation to AI systems?
reference: Any information or documentation obtained by national public authorities or bodies must be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.

question: What conditions allow for the transfer of personal data to a third country when there is neither an adequacy decision nor appropriate safeguards in place?
reference: In the absence of an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, a data transfer to a third country may occur only if the data subject has explicitly consented after being informed of the risks, if the transfer is necessary for a contract or pre-contractual measures between the data subject and the controller, or if it is necessary for the conclusion or performance of a contract concluded in the data subject's interest between the controller and another person.

question: Quels recours une personne physique ou morale possède-t-elle face à une décision juridiquement contraignante d'une autorité de contrôle qui la concerne ?
reference: Toute personne physique ou morale a le droit de former un recours juridictionnel effectif contre une décision juridiquement contraignante d'une autorité de contrôle qui la concerne, sans préjudice de tout autre recours administratif ou extrajudiciaire.

question: What aspects regarding the scientific panel and its members must be included in the implementing act?
reference: The implementing act must include provisions on the conditions, procedures, and detailed arrangements for the scientific panel and its members to issue alerts and request assistance from the AI Office.

question: What actions can the Commission take if a Member State fails to implement corrective measures after being informed that a notified body no longer meets its requirements?
reference: If the Member State fails to take the necessary corrective measures, the Commission may adopt an implementing act to suspend, restrict, or withdraw the designation of the notified body.

question: What type of acts must the Commission adopt to establish detailed arrangements and procedural safeguards for proceedings regarding fines for providers of general-purpose AI models?
reference: The Commission shall adopt implementing acts containing detailed arrangements and procedural safeguards for proceedings in view of the possible adoption of decisions regarding fines for providers of general-purpose AI models.

question: Under what conditions can Union or Member State law provide derogations from data subject rights when personal data is processed for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes?
reference: Derogations from specific data subject rights are permitted if those rights are likely to render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the specific purposes, and the derogations are necessary to fulfill those purposes, provided that the conditions and safeguards regarding data protection are met.

question: Quelles mesures l'autorité de surveillance du marché doit-elle prendre si l'opérateur d'un système d'IA ne prend pas de mesures correctives adéquates dans le délai imparti?
reference: L'autorité de surveillance du marché prend toutes les mesures provisoires appropriées pour interdire ou restreindre la mise à disposition du système d'IA sur son marché national ou sa mise en service, pour le retirer de ce marché ou pour le rappeler, et notifie ces mesures sans retard injustifié à la Commission et aux autres États membres.

question: Quels sont les éléments obligatoires qui doivent figurer dans une demande d'informations adressée en vertu du règlement sur l'IA ?
reference: La demande d'informations doit mentionner sa base juridique et son objet, préciser les informations requises, fixer un délai pour les fournir et indiquer les amendes prévues en cas d'informations inexactes, incomplètes ou trompeuses.

question: Quelle est la date limite pour que les fournisseurs de modèles d'IA à usage général mis sur le marché avant le 2 août 2025 se mettent en conformité avec le règlement ?
reference: Les fournisseurs de modèles d'IA à usage général mis sur le marché avant le 2 août 2025 doivent prendre les mesures nécessaires pour se conformer au règlement au plus tard le 2 août 2027.

question: Which regulation governs the access to documents submitted to members of the Board, experts, and representatives of third parties?
reference: Access to documents submitted to members of the Board, experts and representatives of third parties is governed by Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001.

question: How can providers of high-risk AI systems contained in a product ensure consistency and minimize additional burdens when complying with the AI Act's requirements alongside other relevant Union harmonization legislation?
reference: Providers can choose to integrate the necessary testing and reporting processes, information, and documentation for their product into existing documentation and procedures already required under the Union harmonization legislation listed in Section A of Annex I.

question: Quelles données à caractère personnel la base de données de l’UE pour les systèmes d’IA à haut risque est-elle autorisée à contenir ?
reference: La base de données de l'UE contient uniquement les données à caractère personnel nécessaires à la collecte et au traitement d'informations, incluant les noms et coordonnées des personnes physiques responsables de l'enregistrement et légalement autorisées à représenter le fournisseur ou le déployeur.

question: What must Member States notify to the Commission regarding national provisions adopted for processing and freedom of expression?
reference: Member States must notify the Commission of the provisions of their law adopted for freedom of expression and information, as well as any subsequent amendment law or amendment affecting them without delay.

question: Who must be notified without undue delay of the Board's decision regarding dispute resolution?
reference: The Chair of the Board must notify the decision without undue delay to the supervisory authorities concerned and inform the Commission thereof.

question: Under what conditions can a judgment or administrative decision from a third country requiring a controller or processor to disclose personal data be recognized or enforced?
reference: Such a judgment or decision may only be recognized or enforceable if it is based on an international agreement, such as a mutual legal assistance treaty, in force between the requesting third country and the Union or a Member State, without prejudice to other grounds for transfer.

question: What actions is the AI Office empowered to take regarding providers of general-purpose AI models to carry out its monitoring tasks under this Regulation?
reference: To carry out its tasks, the AI Office may take the necessary actions to monitor the effective implementation and compliance with this Regulation by providers of general-purpose AI models, including checking their adherence to approved codes of practice.

question: Quels sont les objectifs précis pour lesquels les fonctionnalités de journalisation doivent permettre l'enregistrement des événements pertinents dans un système d'IA à haut risque?
reference: Les fonctionnalités de journalisation permettent l'enregistrement des événements pertinents pour repérer les situations à risque ou les modifications substantielles, faciliter la surveillance après commercialisation et surveiller le fonctionnement du système d'IA à haut risque.

question: What tasks regarding certification bodies and mechanisms are assigned to the European Data Protection Board?
reference: The European Data Protection Board is tasked with drawing up codes of conduct and certification mechanisms, carrying out and reviewing the accreditation of certification bodies, maintaining public registers of accredited bodies and third-country controllers or processors, specifying accreditation requirements, and providing opinions to the Commission on certification requirements, icons, and third-country adequacy assessments.

question: Dans quelles conditions exceptionnelles des données à caractère personnel peuvent-elles être conservées pour une durée supérieure à celle nécessaire au regard de leurs finalités initiales?
reference: Les données peuvent être conservées plus longtemps si elles sont traitées exclusivement à des fins archivistiques dans l'intérêt public, à des fins de recherche scientifique ou historique ou à des fins statistiques, à condition que les mesures techniques et organisationnelles appropriées requises pour garantir les droits et libertés de la personne concernée soient mises en œuvre.

question: What technical documentation must be drawn up for a high-risk AI system that is part of a product already covered by EU product-safety harmonisation legislation?
reference: A single set of technical documentation must be drawn up containing all the information required for technical documentation under the AI Act as well as the information required under the applicable Union harmonisation legislation.
note: reworded so it names no annex (the rule flagged 'Annex I'); was: What technical documentation is required when a high-risk AI system related to a product covered by Union harmonisation legislation in Section A of Annex I is placed on the market or put into service?

question: How does the provision on further processing personal data in an AI regulatory sandbox affect existing Union or national laws that exclude processing for unmentioned purposes or provide a basis for developing innovative AI systems?
reference: The provision applies without prejudice to Union or national law that either excludes personal data processing for purposes not explicitly mentioned or establishes a legal basis for processing necessary to develop, test, or train innovative AI systems in compliance with EU data protection law.
note: convoluted: asks what a without-prejudice clause leaves untouched

question: Que doit faire un État membre qui met en place plusieurs autorités de contrôle en ce qui concerne leur représentation et le mécanisme de cohérence ?
reference: Lorsqu'un État membre institue plusieurs autorités de contrôle, il doit désigner celle qui représente ces autorités au comité et définir le mécanisme garantissant le respect par les autres autorités des règles relatives au mécanisme de contrôle de la cohérence.

question: Who makes up the membership of the European Data Protection Board?
reference: The European Data Protection Board is composed of the head of one supervisory authority from each Member State and the European Data Protection Supervisor, or their respective representatives.

question: What is the maximum administrative fine for undertakings that infringe data subjects' rights?
reference: For undertakings, infringements of data subjects' rights are subject to administrative fines of up to 4% of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, or 20,000,000 EUR, whichever is higher.

question: What are the rules regarding the use of real-time remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement purposes?
reference: The use of real-time remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement is prohibited unless it is strictly necessary for targeted searches of abduction, trafficking, or sexual exploitation victims and missing persons, or for prevention objectives.

question: À partir de quel seuil de calcul cumulé d'entraînement un modèle d'IA à usage général est-il présumé présenter des capacités à fort impact ?
reference: Un modèle d'IA à usage général est présumé avoir des capacités à fort impact lorsque la quantité cumulée de calcul utilisée pour son entraînement mesurée en opérations en virgule flottante est supérieure à 10^25.

question: What happens when an AI system that is initially not classified as high-risk is placed on the market or put into service in a way that makes it a high-risk AI system?
reference: A distributor, importer, deployer or other third party that changes the intended purpose of such a system so that it becomes high-risk is considered its provider and takes on the provider's obligations.
note: reference rewritten: the draft only said the system 'becomes subject to responsibilities'; was: Such a system becomes subject to the responsibilities along the AI value chain as outlined for high-risk AI systems under Article 25(1).

question: What fundamental condition must be met when transferring personal data to a third country or international organisation to ensure the regulatory standards are maintained?
reference: Data transfers to a third country or international organisation may only occur if all conditions of the relevant chapter are complied with by the controller and processor, ensuring that the level of protection guaranteed to natural persons is not undermined.

question: Dans quel délai maximal les autorités nationales compétentes doivent-elles informer les demandeurs de leur décision concernant l'accès à un bac à sable réglementaire de l'IA ?
reference: Les autorités nationales compétentes doivent informer les demandeurs de leur décision dans un délai de trois mois à compter de la demande.

question: For how long is the power delegated to the Commission regarding specific articles on transparency and certification?
reference: The power delegated to the Commission is conferred for an indeterminate period of time starting from 24 May 2016.

question: What action can a market surveillance authority take if it cannot conclude its investigation into a high-risk AI system due to an inability to access general-purpose AI model information despite making all appropriate efforts?
reference: The authority may submit a reasoned request to the AI Office to enforce access to that information.

question: What must a provider verify regarding the design, development process, and post-market monitoring of an AI system during the internal control conformity assessment?
reference: The provider must verify that the design and development process of the AI system and its post-market monitoring are consistent with the technical documentation.

question: What kind of documents may the Board issue at the request of the Commission or on its own initiative regarding the implementation and application of the regulation?
reference: The Board may issue recommendations and written opinions on any relevant matters related to the implementation and consistent and effective application of the regulation.

question: Dans quelles conditions une personne agissant sous l'autorité du responsable du traitement ou du sous-traitant est-elle autorisée à traiter des données à caractère personnel ?
reference: Une personne agissant sous l'autorité du responsable du traitement ou du sous-traitant ne peut traiter des données à caractère personnel que sur instruction de ce responsable, à moins d'y être obligée par le droit de l'Union ou d'un État membre.

question: Comment l'analyse d'impact sur les droits fondamentaux d'un système d'IA à haut risque se combine-t-elle avec une analyse d'impact relative à la protection des données déjà réalisée?
reference: L'analyse d'impact sur les droits fondamentaux vient compléter l'analyse d'impact relative à la protection des données si certaines obligations ont déjà été remplies par cette dernière.

question: Quel est l'objectif principal du contrôle humain pour les systèmes d'intelligence artificielle à haut risque ?
reference: Le contrôle humain vise à prévenir ou à réduire au minimum les risques pour la santé, la sécurité ou les droits fondamentaux pouvant survenir lors de l'utilisation d'un système d'IA à haut risque conformément à sa destination ou en cas de mauvaise utilisation raisonnablement prévisible, notamment lorsque ces risques persistent malgré l'application d'autres exigences.

question: De quoi doit-on tenir compte lors de toute modification de ce règlement ou de tout acte délégué ou d'exécution concernant la législation d'harmonisation de l'Union figurant à l'annexe I, section B ?
reference: Toute modification du règlement, acte délégué ou acte d'exécution concernant la législation d'harmonisation de l'Union de l'annexe I, section B, doit tenir compte des spécificités réglementaires de chaque secteur ainsi que des mécanismes de gouvernance, d'évaluation de la conformité, d'applications existants et des autorités établies.
note: names Annex I (rule); obscure amendment clause

question: What information must the requested supervisory authority provide to the requesting supervisory authority regarding mutual assistance requests?
reference: The requested supervisory authority must inform the requesting supervisory authority of the results or progress of the measures taken to respond to the request, and must provide reasons for any refusal to comply.

question: What specific expertise and competencies must the personnel of national competent authorities permanently available under the AI regulations include?
reference: The permanently available personnel of national competent authorities must possess competencies and expertise that include an in-depth understanding of AI technologies, data and data computing, personal data protection, cybersecurity, fundamental rights, health and safety risks, as well as knowledge of existing standards and legal requirements.

question: What powers does the Court of Justice of the European Union have when reviewing a Commission decision to fix a fine for a provider of a general-purpose AI model?
reference: The Court of Justice has unlimited jurisdiction to review such decisions and may cancel, reduce, or increase the imposed fine.

question: Do the derogations for archiving, research, or statistical processing also apply if the processing serves another purpose at the same time?
reference: No, when processing serves another purpose at the same time, the derogations apply exclusively to the processing for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes.

question: What specific details must market surveillance authorities include in their notification when an AI system presents a risk?
reference: The notification must include all available details for identifying the non-compliant system, its origin and supply chain, the nature of the alleged non-compliance and associated risk, the national measures taken and their duration, the relevant operator's arguments, and whether the non-compliance stems from prohibited practices, failure to meet high-risk requirements, shortcomings in harmonised standards or common specifications, or non-compliance with transparency obligations.

question: Qui doit fournir les informations demandées au fournisseur d'un modèle d'IA à usage général, et qui reste responsable si ces informations sont inexactes ?
reference: Les informations doivent être fournies par le fournisseur, son représentant, les personnes autorisées à représenter les entités sans personnalité juridique, ou des avocats habilités, sachant que les clients restent pleinement responsables si les informations fournies sont incomplètes, inexactes ou trompeuses.

question: When must providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities take the necessary steps to comply with the AI Act requirements and obligations, for systems placed on the market before August 2, 2026?
reference: Providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities must take the necessary steps to comply with the requirements and obligations of the Regulation by 2 August 2030.

question: De quoi doit-on tenir compte pour garantir que les systèmes d'IA à haut risque respectent les exigences applicables?
reference: Pour garantir le respect de ces exigences, il est tenu compte de la destination du système, de l'état de la technique généralement reconnu en matière d'IA et de technologies liées à l'IA, ainsi que du système de gestion des risques prévu à l'article 9.

question: Dans quelles conditions les informations sur les essais en conditions réelles enregistrées dans la base de données de l'UE sont-elles accessibles au public ?
reference: Les informations enregistrées conformément à l'article 60 ne sont accessibles au public que si le fournisseur ou le fournisseur potentiel a donné son consentement.
note: reworded so it names no article (the rule flagged 'l'article 60'); was: Dans quelles conditions les informations enregistrées conformément à l'article 60 dans la base de données de l'UE sont-elles accessibles au public?

question: Par quel moyen les États membres doivent-ils concilier le droit à la protection des données personnelles et le droit à la liberté d'expression et d'information ?
reference: Les États membres concilient ces droits par la loi.

question: Are concerned supervisory authorities allowed to adopt a decision on a subject matter submitted to the Board while the dispute resolution periods are ongoing?
reference: No, the concerned supervisory authorities shall not adopt a decision on the subject matter submitted to the Board during the specified dispute resolution periods.

question: What information must be included when a downstream provider lodges a complaint alleging an infringement of the regulation by a general-purpose AI model provider?
reference: A complaint must be duly reasoned and indicate the provider's point of contact, a description of the relevant facts and provisions concerned along with the reasons for alleging the infringement, and any other relevant information the downstream provider wishes to include.

question: What minimum logging capabilities must be provided for high-risk AI systems intended to be used for remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces?
reference: For certain high-risk AI systems, the logging capabilities must at least record the period of each use, the reference database used for checking input data, the specific input data that resulted in a match, and the identification of the natural persons involved in verifying the results.

question: À qui le comité transmet-il ses avis, lignes directrices, recommandations et bonnes pratiques, et que fait-il de ces documents ?
reference: Le comité transmet ses avis, lignes directrices, recommandations et bonnes pratiques à la Commission et au comité visé à l'article 93, et les publie.

question: What principles must personal data processing adhere to regarding accuracy?
reference: Personal data must be accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date, with every reasonable step taken to ensure inaccurate data is erased or rectified without delay.

question: What authority is granted to the Commission regarding the technical documentation requirements in light of technical progress?
reference: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts to amend Annex IV in order to ensure the technical documentation provides all necessary information to assess compliance with the requirements.

question: What legal basis and conditions are required for processing personal data in AI regulatory sandboxes for law enforcement and public security purposes?
reference: Such processing of personal data must be based on a specific Union or national law and be subject to the same cumulative conditions as set out for developing certain AI systems in the public interest within the sandbox.

question: Quelle est la date limite fixée pour que chaque État membre notifie à la Commission les dispositions légales adoptées concernant l'autorité de contrôle ?
reference: Chaque État membre doit notifier à la Commission les dispositions légales adoptées au plus tard le 25 mai 2018, ainsi que toute modification ultérieure les affectant sans tarder.

question: Dans quelles conditions spécifiques le Contrôleur européen de la protection des données dispose-t-il de droits de vote au sein du comité?
reference: Le Contrôleur européen de la protection des données dispose de droits de vote lors des litiges soumis au comité uniquement pour les décisions relatives aux principes et règles applicables aux institutions et organes de l'Union qui sont substantiellement équivalents à ceux du règlement.

question: Quelles entités nationales ont la compétence de déterminer si et dans quelle mesure des amendes administratives peuvent être imposées aux autorités et organismes publics sur leur territoire ?
reference: Chaque État membre peut établir les règles déterminant si et dans quelle mesure des amendes administratives peuvent être imposées à des autorités publiques et à des organismes publics établis sur son territoire.

question: What are the conditions under which the use of AI systems deploying subliminal, manipulative, or deceptive techniques is prohibited?
reference: The use of such AI systems is prohibited when they are deployed beyond a person's consciousness or purposefully to materially distort behavior by impairing informed decision-making, thereby causing or being reasonably likely to cause significant harm.

question: How can the Commission update the thresholds and supplement benchmarks and indicators for general-purpose AI models with systemic risk to reflect technological advancements?
reference: The Commission shall adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 to amend these thresholds and supplement benchmarks and indicators in light of evolving technological developments.

question: Quelles sont les obligations du fournisseur initial lorsqu'un autre acteur devient le nouveau fournisseur d'un système d'IA à haut risque en raison des modifications apportées?
reference: Le fournisseur initial doit coopérer étroitement avec les nouveaux fournisseurs, mettre à disposition les informations nécessaires, fournir l'accès technique raisonnablement attendu et toute autre assistance nécessaire au respect des obligations du règlement, notamment pour l'évaluation de la conformité.

question: Quels types de principes communs doivent contenir les actes d'exécution adoptés par la Commission concernant les bacs à sable réglementaires de l'IA?
reference: Les actes d'exécution doivent contenir des principes communs sur les critères d'éligibilité et de sélection, les procédures de demande, de surveillance, de sortie, d'expiration et de participation (y compris le plan et le rapport de sortie), ainsi que sur les conditions applicables aux participants.

question: Quand la révocation d'une délégation de pouvoir prend-elle effet ?
reference: La révocation prend effet le jour suivant la publication de la décision de révocation au Journal officiel de l'Union européenne ou à une date ultérieure précisée dans cette décision.

question: What actions must market surveillance authorities take when they have sufficient reason to consider that certain general-purpose AI systems usable directly by deployers for a high-risk purpose are non-compliant with regulatory requirements?
reference: When market surveillance authorities have sufficient reason to consider such general-purpose AI systems non-compliant, they must cooperate with the AI Office to carry out compliance evaluations and inform the Board and other market surveillance authorities accordingly.

question: What is the provider required to examine during the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control to evaluate an AI system's compliance with essential requirements?
reference: The provider must examine the information contained in the technical documentation in order to assess the compliance of the AI system with the relevant essential requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.

question: What are the specific chemical additives and manufacturing thresholds required to legally certify a food packaging material as compostable under the EU's Single-Use Plastics Directive?
reference: Neither the EU AI Act nor the GDPR regulates manufacturing standards or chemical certifications for compostable packaging materials under the Single-Use Plastics Directive.

question: Quels sont les délais précis imposés par la directive NIS2 pour la notification d'incidents par les entités essentielles, et quelles sont les sanctions financières maximales en cas de non-respect ?
reference: La directive NIS2 est un acte législatif distinct sur la cybersécurité qui n'est couvert ni par le RGPD ni par l'AI Act.

source: gatekeeper obligations under the Digital Markets Act
question: What specific interoperability requirements must gatekeepers implement for their core platform messaging services under the Digital Markets Act?
reference: The question concerns the Digital Markets Act, which is a separate EU regulation not covered by the EU AI Act or the GDPR.

source: maximum weekly working time under the Working Time Directive
question: What is the maximum limit for weekly working hours, including overtime, for workers under the EU Working Time Directive?
reference: The EU Working Time Directive is a separate piece of EU labor legislation not covered by the scope of either the EU AI Act or the GDPR.

question: What are the specific global and European turnover thresholds that require a concentration to be notified to the European Commission under the EU Merger Regulation?
reference: Neither the GDPR nor the EU AI Act regulates corporate mergers, antitrust, or market competition thresholds.

source: the EU Taxonomy for sustainable activities
question: Quels sont les critères précis de performance environnementale pour qu'une installation de production d'énergie hydroélectrique soit classée comme durable selon le règlement sur la taxonomie de l'UE ?
reference: Le règlement sur la taxonomie de l'UE régit les critères d'investissement durable, qui ne sont abordés ni par le RGPD ni par l'AI Act.

source: security requirements for products with digital elements under the Cyber Resilience Act
question: What are the mandatory vulnerability reporting timelines for manufacturers under the EU Cyber Resilience Act?
reference: The EU Cyber Resilience Act is a distinct cybersecurity regulation for products with digital elements, and its specific provisions are not covered by either the EU AI Act or the GDPR.

source: mutual recognition of professional qualifications in the EU
question: What are the specific language proficiency requirements and bureaucratic procedures for an architect qualified in Spain to have their professional title automatically recognized in Germany under EU freedom of establishment rules?
reference: Neither the EU AI Act nor the GDPR regulates the mutual recognition of professional qualifications or freedom of establishment for professionals like architects.

source: access to data generated by connected products under the Data Act
question: Quelles sont les obligations de garantie légale de conformité pour un téléviseur intelligent vendu à un consommateur en France?
reference: Cette question relève du droit de la consommation et des garanties des biens, qui ne sont régis ni par le RGPD ni par l'AI Act.

source: CE marking of toys under the Toy Safety Regulation
question: Quelles sont les exigences spécifiques de résistance mécanique et de résistance chimique pour qu'un jouet à bascule en bois puisse obtenir le marquage CE ?
reference: Le marquage CE des jouets et leurs exigences techniques de sécurité sont régis par la directive (ou règlement) sur la sécurité des jouets et non par l'AI Act ou le RGPD.

source: VAT rules for cross-border e-commerce sales
question: What are the VAT registration thresholds for a business selling physical goods online to consumers in other EU member states?
reference: The EU AI Act regulates artificial intelligence systems and the GDPR governs personal data protection, neither of which addresses tax legislation or cross-border VAT compliance.
note: reworded: the draft said 'non-EU member states'; was: What are the specific value-added tax (VAT) registration thresholds for a business selling physical goods directly to consumers across different non-EU member states?

question: What is the specific financial compensation an airline must pay to a passenger when a flight within the European Union is cancelled less than 14 days before departure due to an airline staff strike?
reference: This question concerns passenger rights and airline compensation governed by EU Regulation 261/2004, which is outside the scope of both the GDPR and the EU AI Act.

source: licensing of crypto-asset service providers under MiCA
question: What are the specific minimum capital requirements and prudential safeguards for licensing crypto-asset service providers under the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation?
reference: The EU AI Act regulates artificial intelligence systems and the GDPR governs personal data protection, neither of which covers the financial licensing or prudential requirements of crypto-asset service providers.

source: notice-and-action for illegal content under the Digital Services Act
question: What is the mandatory timeframe for online platforms to process and decide upon notices submitted by individuals regarding illegal content under the Digital Services Act?
reference: The Digital Services Act notice-and-action mechanisms are governed by the DSA, which is outside the scope of both the GDPR and the EU AI Act.

source: strong customer authentication for online payments under PSD2
question: What are the exact technical protocols required by the revised Payment Services Directive (PSD2) for implementing multi-factor authentication in cross-border e-commerce transactions?
reference: Neither the EU AI Act nor the GDPR regulates payment services regulations or financial transaction security protocols like PSD2.

source: due diligence under the EU Deforestation Regulation
question: What specific geolocation coordinates and satellite imagery formats are required to submit a due diligence statement for importing rubber into the EU under the Deforestation Regulation?
reference: The EU Deforestation Regulation governs supply chain sustainability for specific commodities, which is entirely outside the scope of both the GDPR (data protection) and the EU AI Act (artificial intelligence).

source: accessibility requirements for e-books under the European Accessibility Act
question: What specific font size and contrast ratios are mandated for reflowable e-books under the European Accessibility Act?
reference: Neither the EU AI Act nor the GDPR regulates the accessibility requirements for e-books, as these are governed by the European Accessibility Act (Directive (EU) 2019/882).

question: What are the specific font size requirements for displaying allergen information on prepacked food labels under EU food information regulations?
reference: Neither the EU AI Act nor the GDPR regulates food safety, labeling standards, or consumer information requirements for food products.

question: What is the maximum surcharge a mobile network operator can apply for data roaming within the European Union under current telecom regulations?
reference: Roaming charge caps and telecommunications pricing are regulated by specific EU electronic communications and roaming market regulations, not by the GDPR or the AI Act.

source: the battery passport under the Batteries Regulation
question: What are the specific chemical thresholds and labeling requirements for heavy metals such as cadmium and lead in industrial batteries under the EU Batteries Regulation?
reference: The EU Batteries Regulation and the GDPR do not govern the chemical composition thresholds and technical labeling standards for industrial batteries.
note: least plausible for an AI Act / GDPR user; 12 test refusals for 10 needed

question: What is the precise formula used by the World Trade Organization to calculate injury margins for anti-dumping duties on imported hot-rolled steel coils?
reference: Neither the EU AI Act nor the GDPR regulates international trade policy, World Trade Organization methodologies, or anti-dumping duty calculations.
note: a WTO methodology, not EU law; 12 dev refusals for 10 needed

source: the 14-day right of withdrawal for online purchases
question: What is the exact procedure and required documentation for returning a defective household appliance under the statutory two-year warranty in an EU member state?
reference: The EU AI Act regulates artificial intelligence systems and the GDPR governs personal data protection, neither of which covers consumer warranty claims or statutory return procedures for physical goods.

source: European Digital Identity Wallets under the eIDAS regulation
question: What are the technical specifications for issuing a European Digital Identity Wallet under the eIDAS regulation, and how do member states handle cross-border recognition of these wallets?
reference: The question pertains to the eIDAS regulation and its technical implementation standards for Digital Identity Wallets, which are not covered by the EU AI Act or the GDPR.

source: reporting under the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
question: Quelles sont les méthodes de calcul exactes que les importateurs doivent utiliser pour déterminer les émissions indirectes intégrées dans les produits en acier importés dans l'UE ?
reference: Le mécanisme d'ajustement carbone aux frontières (MACF) est régi par le règlement (UE) 2023/955, qui relève de la politique climatique et douanière de l'UE et non du RGPD ou de l'AI Act.
